verdict.rationale: A live probe shows Pylon serves an llms.txt at docs.usepylon.com (HTTP 200). It is a structured index linking to markdown versions of the docs pages, such as quickstart.md, which an agent can ingest directly. The docs-md probe hit only a nonexistent path and does not contradict this. Missing for 10: first-party documentation advertising the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
